title: The Amoraim of Nehardea
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Sanhedrin 17b, the designation “the Amoraim of Nehardea” refers to Rav Chama. Sefer HaKeritot, in the part Leshon Limmudim, gate 3, end of chapter 6, reads Rabbi Chanina; Hyman calls this a scribal error.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading supplies the designation “the Amoraim of Nehardea.” The preference for Rav Chama over Rabbi Chanina is Hyman’s textual judgment.

Sanhedrin 17b expressly identifies the Amoraim of Nehardea as Rav Chama. The alternative in Sefer HaKeritot and its rejection as a scribal error are reported by Hyman; that work’s apparatus has not been independently collated here.
